title: feat(spec): draft provenance records MCP build-door writes and the OAuth client that made them
body:
Fixes #27176

## What changes

A pending draft's per-key provenance (`draftChanges`, served on the strict `?state=draft` read) can now say that a key was written by an AI agent outside the console, through a deployment's MCP build door, and which OAuth client that agent was.

**Spec (`@objectstack/spec/api`)**
- `MetadataAuthoringSurfaceSchema` gains `mcp`. All the describes that list the set (`draftChanges[].by`, the save's `surface`, the docblocks) now name it.
- New `MetadataAuthoringClientSchema` (`{ id, name? }`): the OAuth client the person consented to. `id` is the verified token's client id (opaque). `name` is its registered `client_name`, and it is never the id standing in for a name.
- `draftChanges[]` gains an optional `client`, present only beside `by: 'mcp'`.
- `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema` gains an optional `client`. It is stated only by the MCP build door, in-process, from the token it verified. No HTTP door reads it.
- Pinned as isomorphic in `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` (798 → 799). Generated artifacts are regenerated: api-surface, export-origins, declaration-map, authorable-surface and json-schema manifest, reference docs, and the strictness ledger.

**Writer (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`)**
- A draft save with `surface: 'mcp'` stamps `by: 'mcp'` and its `client` on every key path it changes (`draftChangesClient` on the repository `put`, beside `draftChangesBy`). `actor` stays the consenting person.
- A `client` beside any other surface (or with none), or of the wrong shape, is refused `400 INVALID_REQUEST` before anything is read or written. `authoringClientOf` is the one shape check, shared by the save and the stored read.
- `storedDraftChanges` reads `mcp` entries with or without a client. A stored client beside a non-`mcp` surface, or a malformed one, is malformed, like any other bad entry.

**HTTP doors (`@objectstack/rest`, runtime dispatcher)**
- `?surface=mcp` is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with its own sentence, as `?surface=copilot` is. Both doors share `metaSaveRequestOptions`.

**Console**
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`: `MetadataClientSaveOptions.surface` excludes `mcp` as it excludes `copilot`. The type now has a `@ts-expect-error` pin for `mcp`.
- Studio properties (`StudioDraftMark`): the draft chip and the 来源 line mark `mcp` writes as they mark the copilot's. The line names the client: 「由 MCP 客户端「Claude」在 2 分钟前作为草稿加入」 / "Added as a draft by the MCP client "Claude" 2 min ago". A client with no registered name reads as an unnamed MCP client, never by its id.
  - `copilotDraftMarkOf` → `agentDraftMarkOf`. Its marks carry `by` and `client`.
  - The source keys take an `{agent}` hole, with three new `engine.studio.draftMark.agent.*` rows (en + zh, the designer table's two languages).
- Changes drawer (`DraftChangesPanel`): an entry's drill-in already sends the strict draft read. It now reads that read's `draftChanges` too, and lists which AI tools drafted part of the item: the copilot once, and each MCP client once. Copy is in all ten locale packs (`preview.changes.draftedBy*`).
  - Provenance stays off the `_drafts` row, as #24298 ruled. The drawer reads it from the per-item draft read it already sends.

## Why

cloud#3302 opened the MCP build door: an agent with a `metadata:write` grant drafts metadata through the same authoring tools the copilot uses. Its writes were recorded as `api`, so a person reviewing the draft could not tell an agent's edit from any other caller's, or tell which agent it was. The cloud half (the door passing `surface: 'mcp'` and the verified client from its principal into the save) follows once the pin carries this change.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: the five stale artifacts were regenerated and re-checked green. `check:test-typecheck` is OK after updating `meta-item-response-shapes.test.ts` (the surface set and the client type are pinned; the client shape is refused at `draftChanges[n].client`).
- spec: `meta-item-response-shapes.test.ts` and `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` pass (26).
- metadata-protocol: `tsc --noEmit` is clean. `draft-changes.test.ts` and `protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts` pass (103). The new cases cover the client stamp and keep rule, the unnamed client, an `mcp` save without a client, and refusal of a client beside another surface or of the wrong shape, with nothing written.
- rest: `rest-server-meta-door-closed-sets.test.ts` passes (29), with `?surface=mcp` refused. runtime: `meta-save-preconditions-parity.test.ts` passes (23), with `?surface=mcp` refused on the dispatcher too.
- ui:
  - `tsc --noEmit` is clean for `app-shell` and `data-objectstack`.
  - `StudioDraftMark.test.ts`, the new `DraftChangesPanel.agentSource-27176.test.tsx`, and `draftChanges-12725.test.ts` pass.
  - Every `DraftChangesPanel.*` suite and every copilot-mark suite (52 files) passes.
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity` and `check:i18n-dead-keys` show nothing for the new keys.
- `pnpm lint` on the touched files: 0 errors.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## Human Minimum

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.

- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
